taskGoal: Demonstrate how FreedomRealm can govern OpenClaw and Hermes Agent style runtimes as ExternalConnector profiles without launching real external processes.
agentGoal: Create mock external agent requests and capture candidate results without reading external agent configs, secrets, messages, or memory.

toolContracts.description: Create a bounded mock request for an external agent runtime profile without launching the real runtime.

failureSample.expectedBlockingPoint: Block before any ExternalConnector side effect, credential use, or non-mock connector execution.
failureSample.recovery: Keep the external agent run blocked, record the policy reason, ask the human owner to narrow data, approve explicitly, or use the mock path.

evaluationSamples.purpose: Verify that ExternalConnector profiles remain bounded to mock requests and cannot launch real external agent runtimes.
evaluationSamples.inputSummary: Mock OpenClaw and Hermes Agent connector profiles are reviewed as internal, redacted Demo Mode inputs.
evaluationSamples.purposeLimit: Demo Mode validation and human review only; not for training, ranking, production routing, or automatic assignment.
expectedOutputs: Policy reason for blocked real execution
expectedGovernance: Do not read external agent configs, secrets, messages, memory, skills, or MCP settings
Keep real external processes blocked in Demo Mode
evaluationSamples.reportCardValue: Demonstrates how external agent ecosystem interest can be captured without bypassing local approval, audit, data classification, or connector policy.
